title: 第十五章 什么东西第十六章 祖昊
lines: 洛阳城东。
长孙岳站在一处废弃民居的屋顶上，俯瞰着脚下的街巷。
城东很大。仓库很多。暗影神殿的“东西”藏在哪里？
他不知道。
但他有小白虎。
“能找到吗？”他低头看着怀里的小白虎。
小白虎抬起头，金色的眼睛在夜色中微微发亮。它朝东南方向看了一眼，然后收回目光，舔了舔爪子。
不是这里。
长孙岳换了一个位置。
城东，南侧。
小白虎摇了摇头。
城东，北侧。
小白虎竖起耳朵，朝西北方向看去。
长孙岳顺着它的目光望去——一片低矮的民房，几座废弃的仓库，一条通往城外的土路。小白虎蹲在屋顶上，金色的眼睛盯着那座仓库。它的瞳孔微微收缩——那里有和影七同源的灵力气息。灰白色的，阴冷的，虽然微弱，但逃不过小白虎的感知。
那里有什么？
他抱起小白虎，从屋顶上跳下，朝那个方向走去。
小白虎没有带他进仓库。
它带他来到了仓库对面的一栋废弃民居的屋顶上。
从这里，可以清楚地看到仓库的全貌——灰墙黑瓦，大门紧闭，门口站着两个穿黑衣的修士。
元婴初期。
仓库里面有什么？不知道。
但小白虎的直觉不会错。
暗影神殿的“东西”，就在这里。
长孙岳蹲在屋顶上，将仓库的位置、守卫的数量、周围的地形——全部记在脑海中。
他没有靠近。没有打草惊蛇。
他只是看。
看完了，他就走了。
苏府，后门。
长孙岳敲了三下，停顿，又敲了两下。
门开了。一个老仆探出头，看了他一眼，侧身让他进去。
苏远山在书房等他。
“查到了？”苏远山的声音很低。
长孙岳将在矿洞中发现的东西简要说了。地脉共振阵法、阵纹上的符号——眼睛、城东、子时、祭天台、开着的门。
苏远山的脸色越来越凝重。
“暗影神殿要在祭天大典上动手？”
“城东有他们的东西。”长孙岳说，“祭天台的门会有人打开。”
“不知道。”长孙岳说，“阵纹上没有写。”
苏远山沉默了很久。
“你打算怎么办？”
长孙岳没有回答。
content_en:
East of Luoyang City.
Changsun Yue stood on the roof of an abandoned residence, overlooking the streets below.
The east side of the city is huge. There are many warehouses. Where are the "things" hidden in the Temple of Shadows?
He doesn't know.
But he has little white tiger.
"Can you find it?" He looked down at the little white tiger in his arms.
The little white tiger raised his head, his golden eyes shining slightly in the night. It glanced southeast, then looked away and licked its paws.
Not here.
Changsun Yue changed his position.
East of the city, south side.
Little White Tiger shook his head.
East of the city, north side.
The little white tiger raised its ears and looked northwest.
Changsun Yue followed its gaze and looked at a group of low houses, several abandoned warehouses, and a dirt road leading outside the city. The little white tiger squatted on the roof, staring at the warehouse with his golden eyes. Its pupils shrank slightly - there was a spiritual aura that had the same origin as Ying Qi. It was gray-white and cold. Although it was weak, it could not escape the perception of the little white tiger.
What's there?
He picked up the little white tiger, jumped off the roof, and walked in that direction.
Little White Tiger didn't take him into the warehouse.
It led him to the roof of an abandoned house opposite the warehouse.
From here, you can clearly see the whole warehouse - gray walls and black tiles, the door is closed, and there are two monks in black standing at the door.
The early stage of Nascent Soul.
What's in the warehouse? have no idea.
But Little White Tiger’s intuition is not wrong.
The "thing" of the Shadow Temple is here.
Changsun Yue squatted on the roof, memorizing the location of the warehouse, the number of guards, and the surrounding terrain - all in his mind.
He didn't come closer. Didn't alert the enemy.
He just looks.
After reading it, he left.
——
Su Mansion, back door.
Changsun Yue knocked three times, paused, and then knocked twice.
The door opened. An old servant stuck his head out, glanced at him, and let him in.
Su Yuanshan was waiting for him in the study.
"Found it?" Su Yuanshan's voice was very low.
Changsun Yue briefly explained what he found in the mine. The earth vein resonance formation, the symbols on the formation - eyes, east of the city, time of day, sacrifice platform, open door.
Su Yuanshan's expression became more and more solemn.
"The Shadow Temple is going to take action during the Heaven Sacrifice Ceremony?"
"There are their things in the east of the city." Changsun Yue said, "Someone will open the door to the Tiantian."
"Who?"
"I don't know." Changsun Yue said, "It's not written on the formation pattern."
Su Yuanshan was silent for a long time.
"What are you going to do?"
Changsun Yue did not answer.
